A new round of heavy rainfall began affecting areas north of the Yangtze River, prompting the Central Meteorological Observatory to issue an orange alert for heavy rain. The rainfall caused urban flooding in multiple northern cities including Beijing, Taiyuan, and Handan, leading to traffic disruptions and trapping 19 people in Handan's Yongnian County who were subsequently rescued.
